summary: Finished and shipped L-20261029-01, 'How airlines really make money (it isn't the seats)', 8:13, from yesterday's fact-checked draft now that the improver fixed the build camera and the facepalm phone.
why: state: 1 of 3 long videos this week, backlog 0. The airlines topic was first in Scout's feed (high priority, score 8.31) and yesterday's draft had failed only on scene bugs fixed this morning.

findings.title: Number check and fact review passed first time
findings.detail: 65 figures from code. Fact review passed with notes: c6-flow says all fees flow to the loyalty programme (they go mainly to the issuing bank); c5-split leaves out the network's cut; 2% swipe fee is a US level.

findings.title: QA: two fix rounds, then pass
findings.detail: Round 1: repeated grid thumbnail, coins on the captions (c5-shrink), a label on the captions (c2-holiday), a misleading fees callout (c6-chart), lettering behind text (c4-tons), heads cropped top-left (c5-split, c5-signup, c6-flow). Round 2: c5-signup still cropped. Round 3: pass. Render gates ok, 493 s, peak -1.0 dB, mean -16.3 dB.

findings.title: One thumbnail, not three
findings.detail: The scene thumbnail failed the phone-size check twice (blurred frame, with figures) and the grid was the last video's picture again; shipped with the face thumbnail 'Plane? No. Bank.' (angle versus, the best performer). Logged for the improver.

findings.title: Lost about 50 minutes to a stuck watcher
findings.detail: The first stills failed in minutes on a missing thumbnail `who` (a bare ZodError), but the wait loop matched its own command and never returned. Wait on the render's PID, not pgrep -f.
